name: A commercial KPI rollup zeroes WOS inputs when unverified and GMROI inputs when missing_cost so both ratios evaluate to null (withheld) directly on the read path.

payload.rationale: A commercial KPI rollup zeroes WOS inputs when unverified and GMROI inputs when missing_cost so both ratios evaluate to null (withheld) directly on the read path.
